subject: Renewal: Tiered upshift, invoice phasing & prorated discount plan

Subject: Renewal: Tiered upshift, invoice phasing & prorated discount plan

Hi Amira / Gabe,

Thanks again for the productive renewal call yesterday. Per our discussion, I put together a focused option that aligns Greenlens's growth plan (20% q/q token increase expected) with a predictable unit price while giving you a short-term cash flow cushion. High-level: 

- Term: 12 months starting 2027-07-01 with an option to extend at a pre-negotiated rate.
- Commit structure: Retainer -> Reserved conversion: 80% of current retainer converts to Reserved Capacity, the remainder stays as burstable usage.
- Pricing: Tiered effective per-token discount that increases as monthly committed units step up (see attached pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx).
- Invoice phasing: We can split the first quarter into two invoices (prorated) to smooth your cash flow.
- One-time onboarding credit: $15k applied to the first invoice to offset migration work.

Action items:
1) Can you confirm Greenlens wants the Reserved conversion (80/20) and the July 1 start?
2) If yes, I'll route to Finance for an invoice-phasing approval and to Legal for a short amendment (no changes to SLA).

I've attached a short proposal (Greenlens_Renewal_Proposal_v2.pdf) + the pricing matrix. If you prefer, we can move the onboarding credit into the first two invoices instead of one.

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0241

- Invoice phasing proposal sounds helpful. Can you do: 40% of first quarter on July invoice, 60% on August (prorated) so our Q3 budget lines up?

Also, legal asked me to confirm there won’t be an auto-renew at higher pricing without 60 days notice.

If you can send a version with those three items called out explicitly, I’ll share with Legal and Procurement and get a PO started. Attaching our internal renewal checklist.

Sergio / Marissa / Amira,

Thanks for the context. Quick summary of approvals and a suggested amendment text below. High-level: Legal is comfortable with the commercial asks provided we keep the change narrowly scoped (amendment + schedule) and preserve current SLAs. Proposed decisions: 

1) Reserved reallocation window: we will allow intra-account reallocation of Reserved capacity for up to 6 months from the effective date. This is an operational flag in our billing system and will be documented in the amendment.

2) Invoice phasing: Finance approves a 40% / 60% split for Q3 for the first quarter of the term. The onboarding credit of $15,000 will be applied as a prorated credit across the July and August invoices (8,000 July / 7,000 August). This keeps revenue recognition tidy while honoring Greenlens's cash-flow ask.

3) Auto-renew: Amendment will specify that any renewal with higher rates requires 60 days' written notice. We will not auto-enroll at a higher rate without notice.

Next steps: Sergio / Marissa to confirm final pricing rows and send the amendment (one-page schedule + pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx). Once Amira signs off, we prepare a DocuSign for signature and Amira can push the PO.

Suggested amendment (excerpt):
"Schedule A — Reserved Conversion & Billing Terms: Effective 2027-07-01, Customer converts 80% of current retainer to Reserved Capacity. Reserved Capacity may be reallocated across Greenlens accounts for a period of six (6) months from the effective date. Initial invoice for the first quarter will be billed in two installments (40% on July invoice; 60% on August invoice). A one-time onboarding credit of $15,000 shall be applied prorated across the July and August invoices. Any renewal resulting in higher unit pricing will require sixty (60) days' written notice to Customer prior to the renewal effective date."

Amira — if that language looks ok, I can mark up the attached proposal and route to Marissa for pricing finalization.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
